limitations: Phase 9 verifies impact analysis, cache reuse, selective rebuild, selective rescore and paired-report contracts with fixtures; no live production remediation run was performed.
Cache reuse requires exact content, producer and preprocessing identities and fails closed when evidence is incomplete.
The rescore safety band and dependency evidence select work; they do not establish that an individual prior decision was wrong.
Paired point-estimate deltas do not alone establish improvement, and uncertainty is reported only for the paired accuracy change.
Compute avoidance and review effort are unavailable unless supplied with an explicit measured or estimated evidence basis; fixture quantities are not production claims.
No production accuracy gain, corrected-error total, reviewer throughput, cost reduction or time-saving benefit is claimed.

tasks.outcome: Propagates changed references, species, routes and regions through a validated acyclic dependency graph while persisting unaffected artifacts as reusable.
Reuses exact content-addressed Flickr and reference embeddings, filters excluded references without recomputation and embeds only cache misses.
Selects only affected prototypes, candidate indexes and classifier work, rebuilding calibrators only when fingerprinted training evidence changes.
Selectively rescores target, competitor, candidate-union, removed-reference, margin-band and incomplete-evidence cases while reusing unrelated scores.
Pairs human-labelled before and after records, reports corrected and new errors, metric deltas, unit-preserving work evidence and identity-component bootstrap uncertainty.
